main_text.p: עֲרֵמָה f. Acervus: plur. עֲרֵמוֹת & עֲרָמִים.
עַרְמוֹן m. Platanus, vel juxta alios, Castanea arbor: plur. עַרְמוֹנִים.
עָרוֹם m. Nudus: plural. עֲרוּמִים. Fœmin. עֲרוּמָה.
עָרוֹם m. Idem: item Nuditas: plur. עֲרֻמִים. נֵעֲרָמִים m. p. Nudi.
עֲרִיסָה f. Massa farinæ subactæ: plur. עֲרִיסוֹת.
עָרַף Cervicem amputare, Decollare, quod metaphoricè etiam de aliis dicitur, quibus cervices & cornua tribuuntur, Hos. 10. 2: item stillare. Deut 33 28.

עָרַץ Violentiâ uti, Violenter exagitare, Violentum esse, Violenter Frangere aut Confringere: item Formidavit, Expavit, Consternatus fuit. Niphal Partic. נַעֲרָץ Formidabilis. Hiphil הֶעֱרִיץ Formidavit.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words are transcribed from a low-contrast scan; vowel points and some letters are doubtful and marked [?] where uncertain. The left margin has a small printer's mark ("1") at the foot, which was not transcribed. Water stains and show-through obscure parts of the page.
